adrs: Reuse the canonical TypeScript requirement, governed RAG, ReportDesign, normalization, guardrail, PBIP compiler and candidate-validation implementation through one typed bounded internal execution bridge; create no second generator or public generation microservice.

Generation is a server-authorised consequential command bound to the exact current case, request, conversation, evidence, interpretation and ConfirmedRequirementContract versions; browser assertions never create readiness, validity, artifact identity or success.

Persist immutable generation attempts, exact input bindings, timestamps, status, provenance, validation findings, failure reasons, candidate associations and supersession history in PostgreSQL with payload-bound idempotency, optimistic concurrency, audit consistency and late-result fencing.

Use a private local-volume artifact adapter for local and CI only; store bytes outside repository and public web roots and require current company plus private-case or output permission for every read and download.

Artifact writes are bounded, atomic, digest-bound and ineligible until every mandatory deterministic check passes; incomplete, failed, orphaned, traversed, symlinked or malformed artifacts never become downloadable candidates.

Existing AI and provider adapters remain the ordinary production-path design authority, while deterministic substitutes are permitted only in explicit local or test simulation and must be labelled as simulation rather than silently replacing provider failure.

ConfirmedRequirementContract remains business-semantic authority and ReportDesign remains subordinate; changed material meaning requires new confirmation and changed candidate bytes require fresh applicable validation and candidate-bound governance.
APBRA-164 is local and CI only, synthetic-data only and AUD 0 cloud spend; no live model, Entra, Azure, customer data, public endpoint, Power BI Service publication or Desktop PASS is authorised.

acceptance_criteria: An authorised user can submit one payload-bound idempotent generation command only for the exact current accepted case, evidence, interpretation and ConfirmedRequirementContract versions.

Every protected generation, status, history and artifact operation re-evaluates active membership and private case or output permission; foreign, ungranted, revoked and deactivated access fails without revealing protected existence.

The bounded internal bridge consumes typed immutable inputs, invokes the existing canonical TypeScript generation and validation pipeline without shell interpolation or uncontrolled paths, and returns typed bounded results or explicit failure.

Governed RAG, ReportDesign creation, correction, normalization, semantic and capability validation, guardrails, compiler and candidate validation preserve their existing bounded authority and fail-closed behavior.

Deterministic local or test simulation is visibly labelled and cannot become a silent production fallback; provider, citation, semantic, compiler, validation, storage and cancellation failures remain truthful failures.

PostgreSQL durably retains attempt ID, exact version bindings, timestamps, status, provenance, failure reason, candidate association and supersession or regeneration history across API and database restart.
Duplicate equivalent commands return the same logical attempt; changed payload under the same idempotency key conflicts; concurrent requests cannot create divergent active work or outputs.
Cancellation, retry and late result handling preserve aggregate budgets, fence stale work and recheck current permissions before any result becomes eligible.

Private local artifacts are outside repository and web roots, safe-identified, traversal and symlink protected, atomically written, bounded, digest verified and exposed only after mandatory candidate validation passes.
Old attempts and outputs remain immutable historical evidence after changed meaning, new confirmation or regeneration; approval and runtime evidence do not transfer to changed bytes.
The real browser to API to PostgreSQL to canonical pipeline to protected local artifact journey covers success, refresh, restart, failure, regeneration and denied download using synthetic data.
At least three unrelated synthetic domains and renamed fields exercise one generic path without scenario, fixture, prompt, filename, KPI, table, column or layout recipes.
No Package D expert continuation, cloud resource, public deployment, live model call, live Entra, customer data, Power BI Service publication, gateway or Desktop PASS is implemented or claimed.
